dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (When I was young, I used to think Piramida was never more alive than during the banquets at the great mead hall.)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (I wasn't a Lightkeeper then — just helping out with everyone else in the kitchen. The real appeal of a banquet, to me, was getting food we didn't usually get to eat otherwise.)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (That's why I could never understand back then why the older members at the table would always burst into tears after a few drinks.)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (It wasn't until I became a Ratnik myself that I started weeping harder than anyone else...)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: (Our comrades' sacrifices paved the way for us, and only by eating our fill can we find the strength to carry on. This, I suppose, is the true meaning of these banquets.)
